verdict.rationale: Milvus docs describe setting up an MCP server (officially published under zilliztech) so AI applications can run vector searches, manage collections, and retrieve data using natural-language commands without writing database queries. This only works through a separate MCP server and an external LLM client, not natively in Milvus itself. Missing for 10: native natural-language interface in the core product, detailed coverage of which operations work via natural language (e.g., admin/RBAC, inserts), independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language workflow works in practice.
